auth.errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

sign_in.errors.email_required: Enter your work email to continue

forgot_password.description: Enter your work email. If an admin account exists, we'll send a recovery link.

reset_password.meta_title: Create a new password · Alvo Admin
reset_password.title: Create a new password
reset_password.description: This replaces your current password. You'll be signed out of all other sessions.
reset_password.errors.password_weak: Your password does not meet all the requirements
reset_password.errors.mismatch: Passwords do not match. Check and try again.
reset_password.errors.rejected: This password can't be used. Choose a different one.
reset_password.updated.title: Password updated
reset_password.updated.description: Your new password is active. All previous sessions have been signed out for security.
reset_password.expired.title: Link has expired
reset_password.expired.description: This recovery link is no longer valid. Links expire after 15 minutes for security. Request a new one below — no need to re-enter your email.
reset_password.expired.alert: Short expiry windows prevent intercepted links from being used later. Your account is safe, just request a fresh link.
reset_password.resent.title: New link sent
reset_password.resent.description: A fresh recovery link was sent to {maskedEmail}. The previous link has been invalidated.
reset_password.resent.alert: Check your inbox now. The link expires quickly. If you don't see it, check spam or contact your system admin.
